pages.title: Privacy and cookies
pages.description: How Artan Records Studio handles account information and your choices.
pages.text: Your account Studio account information is used to provide access, maintain your artist profile and respond to your requests. Creating an account does not grant access to another artist's work or financial records. Profile photographs and unreleased submissions are not public catalogue content. Cookies and similar technologies Essential browser storage supports sign-in and security. Your cookie choice is remembered in this browser. Optional appearance storage is used only after Allow; Skip leaves it off. You can revisit Cookies & preferences in the footer. External services apply their own notices when you visit them. Your choices For access, correction, deletion or privacy questions, contact contact@artanrecords.com. Some records may need to be retained to meet contractual or legal obligations. Account and payment services will be described here when connected; no banking or tax information should be submitted through public forms.

pages.title: Studio terms
pages.description: Access to Artan Records Studio and artist services.
pages.text: Accounts and artist access Use accurate account information and protect your credentials. An account is separate from an artist agreement; label-managed approval determines access to artist workspaces. Do not access another person's records or submit work without permission. Your work Submit only material you are entitled to share. A submission is not an agreement to release or distribute a recording. Distribution, rights, royalty splits and payment obligations require a separate confirmed agreement. Royalties and payments Listening statistics are not a royalty statement. Earnings, deductions, currencies, reporting periods and payout eligibility depend on verified reports and the applicable agreement. No payout amount or date is promised by an unconnected workspace. Payment or identity onboarding must use the designated secure provider; do not send bank details through public enquiries. Help and statutory rights Contact contact@artanrecords.com for access or service questions. These terms do not remove rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Financial services, charges and payment-provider terms must be disclosed before those features are activated.
